notes.title: What's next?
notes.content:
I'm really [b]excited [/b] about the steam page finally being up. [b]Hurray![/b]

As for the game the [b]main mechanics[/b] are there and they're [b]solid[/b].
 
So the [b]focus [/b] is on [b]content[/b]:
[list]
[*] More weapons to unlock for the mecha (meta progression).
[*] Bigger variety of upgrades during runs. I really want the game to offer many different ways for the player to survive the hordes.
[*] Final boss fight against Evil Skullhead.
[*] I would LOVE to add more maps, but I will see if that's feasible after I'm done with all the other stuff on the list.
[/list]

I'll post updates here with the progress as often as I can.
